name: npm package cache
description: The package tarballs and registry responses npm keeps so it does not download them twice (its _cacache store, the same thing 'npm cache clean' removes). npm treats a missing entry as a cache miss and fetches it again, so the cost is bandwidth, and an install with no network will need it back. If npm is mid-install when this runs, one fetch may fail once and then succeed. Installed packages, node_modules, 'npx' installs and npm's logs and settings are NOT touched. Only npm's default cache location is covered: a cache moved with NPM_CONFIG_CACHE or an .npmrc is not followed.
